name: 911-scraper-mcp

tools.name: scrape_url
tools.description: Scrape any webpage and extract content using 911Proxy Universal Scraper. Supports HTML extraction and PNG screenshots. When requesting PNG format, JavaScript rendering is automatically enabled. Screenshots are saved to local files (not returned as base64 to avoid token limits). IMPORTANT: When user requests both HTML and screenshot, make TWO separate tool calls instead of using format: ['html', 'png'] - first call with format: ['html'], then second call with format: ['png']. Using both formats in one call will only return HTML.

format.description:
Output format selection - IMPORTANT: Choose based on user intent:

            Use ["html"] when user says:
            - "抓取/爬取/获取 [网站/网页/页面] 内容" (scrape/crawl/get content)
            - "查看/分析 [网站] 源码/HTML" (view/analyze source/HTML)
            - "提取 [网站] 数据/信息" (extract data/info)
            - Does NOT mention "截图/screenshot"

            Use ["png"] when user says:
            - "截图/截屏/拍照 [网站]" (take screenshot/capture)
            - "保存/生成 [网页] 图片" (save/generate image)
            - "给我看 [网站] 的样子/外观" (show me how it looks)
            - Explicitly asks for image/picture

            Use ["html", "png"] - NOT RECOMMENDED, API will only return HTML and ignore PNG request

            IMPORTANT: When user wants both HTML and screenshot, make TWO separate scrape_url calls:
            - First call: format: ["html"] - Get HTML content
            - Second call: format: ["png"] - Get screenshot
            This ensures you get both formats successfully.

            NOTE: If 'png' is selected, js_render will be automatically enabled (API requirement).

screenshot_type.description: Screenshot type (only for png format): full_page or viewport

js_render.description: Enable JavaScript rendering for dynamic content (SPAs). NOTE: Automatically set to true when format includes 'png' (API requirement). For HTML-only requests, defaults to false.

geo.description: Country code for proxy location (e.g., US, HK, GB, JP). Note: CN is not supported and will be automatically mapped to HK (Hong Kong).

tools.name: scrape_urls_batch
tools.description: Scrape multiple URLs at once using 911Proxy Universal Scraper. Useful for batch processing multiple pages. When requesting PNG format, JavaScript rendering is automatically enabled. Screenshots are saved to local files. WARNING: Batch requests take longer (30-60s per URL with JS rendering). For 3+ URLs or when using js_render, consider using individual scrape_url calls instead to avoid timeouts.

format.description:
Output format selection - Choose based on user intent:

            ["html"] - When user wants to scrape/crawl/extract content (default)
            ["png"] - When user wants screenshots/captures of pages
            ["html", "png"] - ONLY when user explicitly requests both formats

            NOTE: If 'png' is selected, js_render will be automatically enabled (API requirement).

screenshot_type.description: Screenshot type (only for png format): full_page or viewport

js_render.description: Enable JavaScript rendering for dynamic content. NOTE: Automatically set to true when format includes 'png' (API requirement).

geo.description: Country code for proxy location (e.g., US, HK, GB, JP). Note: CN is not supported and will be automatically mapped to HK.

tools.name: open_screenshots_folder
tools.description: Open the screenshots folder in the file manager. Use this when the user asks to see/view/show the screenshots, or wants to open the folder containing saved images. Works on Windows (Explorer), macOS (Finder), and Linux (file manager).
